## 3. Major Engineering Projects & Source Repositories

### Design Swiftly — Browser CAD/CAM Engine
- **Source Scale**: 92,231 lines of source code across 494 files.
- **Technologies**: Rust, WebAssembly (WASM), TypeScript, Web Serial API, WebGL.
- **Description**: Browser-native CAD/CAM tool enabling real-time 3D toolpath simulation, G-code parsing, and direct hardware serial connection to CNC machinery without external desktop drivers.

### AI Traffic Management System
- **Technologies**: Python, YOLOv8, Computer Vision, OpenCV, PyTorch.
- **Description**: Real-time urban automation system analyzing camera video streams to dynamically control traffic signal timing based on vehicle density.

### Learn Quran — Global Educational Ecosystem
- **Technologies**: Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, WebSockets, WebRTC.
- **Description**: Socio-educational platform connecting tutors with learners worldwide via low-latency audio/video streaming and interactive digital whiteboards.
